issues.description: The problem statement requires the student to store the result in a variable named `score_counter`, but the solution repository declares the variable as `score_cnt`. This is an unintended identifier naming mismatch for the same conceptual entity (the result counter) and will confuse students who follow the problem text or any automated checks that expect `score_counter`.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename the identifier in the solution to match the problem statement: change the declaration `score_cnt dd 0` to `score_counter dd 0`. Alternatively, if `score_cnt` was intended, update the problem statement to request `score_cnt` — but aligning the solution to `score_counter` is the preferred fix to avoid student confusion.
